title: CDE对亚裔SLE患者高暴露量安全性的监管要求（CTA申报策略）

background.text: CDE要求在CTA申报时提供详细理由，说明亚裔SLE患者增加暴露量不存在安全风险；临床药理部门建议在全球II期临床试验中，先在中国患者中入组低剂量（25mg BID）组，比较PK/PD及安全性数据，若基本一致再入组更高剂量组。
background.quote: Clin-pharm division: It is recommended that in the global Phase II clinical trial, enroll Chinese patients in low-dose (25mgBID) arm firstly and compare the PK, PD and safety data obtained from these Chinese patients with the entire population. If the above characteristics are basically consistent, then enroll Chinese patients in higher dose arms.

background.text: 临床部门要求在CTA中证明增加暴露量对亚裔SLE患者无安全风险；临床药理部门于8月27日提交了反驳CDE建议的策略，并于8月26日召开了全球与本地团队对齐会议。
background.quote:
Clin-pharm division: Strategy to push back CDE‘s recommendation (submitted on 27 Aug）
Alignment meeting on 26 Aug  – global & local teams

background.text: CDE于8月29日接受并进一步评论：建议综合考虑现有数据以确保受试者安全，并要求在CTA申报时提供详细理由说明亚裔SLE患者增加暴露量不存在安全风险。
background.quote:
CDE accepted with further comment on 29 Aug:
Suggest to comprehensively consider the available data to ensure the safety of the subjects. When submit the CTA, please provide the detailed rationale that no safety risk to increase exposure in Asian SLE patients.

background.text: 临床药理部门后续行动要求：在CTA中证明增加暴露量对亚裔SLE患者无安全风险。
background.quote: Justify in the CTA that increased exposure poses no safety risk for Asian SLE patients.

todo.text: 在CTA申报文件中提供详细理由，证明亚裔SLE患者增加暴露量不存在安全风险（owner：临床部门及临床药理部门）。
todo.quote: Justify in the CTA that increased exposure poses no safety risk for Asian SLE patients.

title: 研究1509-0004 Leading PI选定（李梦涛，北京协和医院）
